title: Use Seedance 2.0’s “up to 9 pics” image-to-cinematic-sequenc...
content:
Use Seedance 2.0’s “up to 9 pics” image-to-cinematic-sequence feature (includes sound effects and music) to generate a 15s scene from multiple images.  
Repeat 15s generations to create all scenes, then stitch the scenes together in any video editor.
description:
Seedance 2.0 turns your images into a a really cool cinematic sequence - with sound effects and music included.

This specific feature (up to 9 pics): $0.26 per 15s

Standard multi-shot (1-2 images): $0.13 per 15s

That’s ridiculously cheap, especially compared to Sora 2.

Then just repeat the process until you get all your scenes made and stitch them together in any video editor.

ja.title: Seedance 2.0の「up to 9 pics」イメージからシネマティックシーケンスへの機能（効果音と音楽を含む）
ja.content:
Seedance 2.0の「up to 9 pics」イメージからシネマティックシーケンスへの機能（効果音と音楽を含む）を使用して、複数の画像から15秒のシーンを生成します。  
15秒の生成を繰り返してすべてのシーンを作成し、任意のビデオエディタでシーンをつなぎ合わせます。
